title: Briefe adeliger Frauen (16.-18. Jh.): Beziehungen und Bezugssysteme
institution: Institut für Geschichte, Universität Wien (project funded by the FWF; contact Alexander Sperl)
notes: Letters of Austrian noblewomen from family archives (Schallenberg, Starhemberg and others), with transcriptions and short summaries, plus lists of the wider holdings (about 2,900 letters, 16th-18th century). Counts are ours from the "Alle Briefe" page: 258 letters marked as individual letters and about 52,000 words on that page, which includes the summaries and headings; the letters transcribed there are dated 1494 to 1678, none after 1700. The site dates from 1999-2004 (last modified November 2004).
